title: new to AI game dev, though I've dev'd games for 25 years
author: YamSubject2636
selftext:
I'm new to vibe coding, currently using Rosebud. I'm in the process of making 4 games, so thought I'd share some videos of the WIP's.

  
I've been a full time developer since 1998, with titles like Homeworld, KotOR, Jade Empire, Mass Effect, Dragon Age, Mythforce, The Other Worlds 2.

I'm a sound designer/composer - so my games are pretty decent on the audio front.

I'm living like it's 1980, making Vector Arcade inspired games. Please have a look if this interests you!!

[https://www.youtube.com/@OscilloscopeArts](https://www.youtube.com/@OscilloscopeArts)

  
and a beta version of one is here :: [https://rosebud.ai/d/vector-grid](https://rosebud.ai/d/vector-grid) \- controller friendly, but not mobile friendly. 99 levels and 99 tunes, one for each level!

comments.author: u3030
comments.body: Cool style and it definitely shows that you're a sound designer, the music is great and really hits that retro vibe.  Just be careful or the mcp will pull you into the game grid ;)

replies.author: YamSubject2636
replies.body: haha, one can only hope! Thx for the reply and checking them out!

comments.author: JoanofArc0531
comments.body: Did you work on the beautiful Catholic Agnus Dei hymn from Homeworld?

replies.author: YamSubject2636
replies.body: no, that was my boss Paul... I did a bunch of the ship sound effect drones

comments.author: HealthyWest6482
comments.body: I love it. I can tell you're having so much fun with it too

replies.author: YamSubject2636
replies.body: thanks!! Yup, super fun to do what I want to do! So different than my dev days when you're trying to make a "product" for "the market" lol
